scope: Pure practice-range admission and exact playback-boundary decisions; no media, editor history, storage, or service changes.

contract.createPracticeRange: Validate the complete supplied cue graph using validateCues; refuse omitted lines and empty, fractional, reversed, or outside selections. Return a frozen scalar snapshot containing firstIndex, lastIndex, exact selected start/end, and clipDuration. Intervening instrumental gaps are included. Inputs and literal text remain unchanged.
contract.practiceBoundary: Validate scalar range invariants, once/repeat mode, and a finite position within the existing clip duration. Refuse a position before the range start. Return continue for [start,end), then finish or repeat at or after end. No epsilon, rounding, timestamp fitting, or media effects. The caller owns seeking and calls only after its seek settles.
